original_description: Build a navigable Matterport-style 360° virtual tour from a folder of equirectangular panoramas of a property. Analyzes each panorama with vision to classify the room, detect doorways/openings, place navigation hotspots at the right yaw/pitch, generate the title, description, caption and narration script, and wire the rooms into a connected, bidirectional graph written to tour.json — then verifies it with an overlay render and the local viewer. Use this whenever the user wants to create, build, generate, author, stitch, or assemble a 360 tour, virtual tour, panorama tour, property walkthrough, or interactive real-estate walkthrough; whenever they have equirectangular / 360 / panorama room images and want them connected with hotspots; or whenever they mention placing hotspots, linking rooms, or generating tour.json / scene metadata — even if they don't say the word "skill".

final_description: Connect, link, or wire up a folder of 360°/equirectangular room panoramas into a navigable virtual tour you click through room to room. Use this for any request to build, assemble, generate, author, or wire panoramas/scenes/rooms of a home, flat, apartment, or property into an interactive, clickable tour, walkthrough, or real-estate walkthrough; to place navigation/doorway hotspots and work out each one's yaw/pitch; to figure out which room each pano shows and link them into a walkable graph where every room is reachable; or to write a tour.json (e.g. for photo-sphere-viewer) with per-room titles, descriptions, and narration. Casual phrasing counts, and the word "skill" need not appear. Do NOT use it for shooting or compressing/resizing panoramas, extracting EXIF/GPS, building plain photo galleries, or debugging the viewer's rendering/WebGL errors — only for authoring the tour itself.
